title: Safe to Omit, Worth Omitting? Keeping the Answer and Cutting Latency When an LLM Agent Skips Another's Message
abstract: arXiv:2611.23570v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In multi-agent systems, a receiver agent often waits for a helper agent's message (text or its latent KV cache), which can improve performance but adds latency. We study when a receiver agent can skip the message safely (the final answer rarely changes) and beneficially (the time saved exceeds the cost of deciding). Our mechanism reads the receiver agent's confidence without the message and uses a finite-sample test to certify a threshold at which, with high probability, at most 5% of skipped answers change; if none passes, the system keeps communicating. We test it on OpenBookQA, ARC-Challenge, and MMLU-Pro with three Qwen model pairs, on cross-family agents, and on SQuAD and GSM8K. Four insights emerge. First, oracle headroom is weak evidence that messages help: control inputs without answer-specific content, matched to change answers as often as real messages, reproduce a median 76% of the oracle's gain. translated_title: 可以安全省略，也值得省略吗？当LLM智能体跳过另一方的消息时，保持答案不变并降低延迟
translated_abstract: 在多智能体系统中，接收方智能体通常需要等待辅助智能体的消息（文本或其潜在KV缓存），这可以提升性能但会增加延迟。我们研究接收方智能体何时可以安全地（最终答案很少改变）且有益地（节省的时间超过决策本身的开销）跳过该消息。我们的机制在不读取该消息的情况下获取接收方智能体的置信度，并使用有限样本检验来认证一个阈值——在该阈值下，以高概率保证被跳过时答案的改变率不超过5%；如果没有阈值能通过检验，系统则继续保持通信。我们在OpenBookQA、ARC-Challenge和MMLU-Pro上使用三对Qwen模型进行测试，也在跨家族的智能体组合以及SQuAD和GSM8K上进行了测试。我们得到四点洞察。首先，“oracle上限空间”是消息有帮助作用的弱证据：不含答案特定内容、但被匹配为与真实消息同样频繁改变答案的控制输入，能够重现oracle收益的中位数76%。其次，一条消息能否……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于无消息置信度读取与有限样本统计检验的机制，使多智能体LLM系统中的接收方智能体能够以高概率保证答案改变率不超过5%地安全跳过辅助智能体的消息，在保持最终答案质量的同时有效降低通信延迟，并揭示了消息增益远小于oracle上限的量化证据。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a mechanism that reads the receiver agent's confidence without the message and uses a finite-sample test to certify a threshold, enabling a receiver agent in multi-agent LLM systems to safely skip a helper's message with a high-probability guarantee that at most 5% of answers change, thereby cutting communication latency while preserving answer quality.
